From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Mills <sara.mills@hearthwell.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@hearthwell.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Lewis <ben.lewis@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Request: AWS co-sell warm intro for Hearthwell — demo scope & procurement runway

Hi Sara & Devon —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Per our conversation, Hearthwell is evaluating an LLM inference platform for customer-facing assistance and internal summarization (short pilot: 3-4 week POC). AWS recommended we coordinate a warm intro to the Marketplace co-sell workflow so we can align on procurement timing and an AWS-backed demo.

Request / asks:
- Can we get a 30–45m intro with you + the procurement lead (if available) and Ben from AWS to map the procurement runway?
- On our side we’ll do a focused 20m demo (typical POC scope: 2-4 models, sandbox integration, metrics collection) and walk through the mutual action plan (MA).
- Please find a short PoI attached that outlines expected deliverables and timeline.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Wed 10/22 09:00–10:00
- Thu 10/23 11:00–12:00
- Fri 10/24 14:00–15:00

If those don’t work, please propose two alternatives and we’ll do our best to accommodate. 

Attachments: Hearthwell_Redwood_POI.pdf

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Hi Logan —

Thanks — all helpful. We’re interested and would like to get Ben looped in so we can understand the Marketplace path vs. direct procurement. Devon (cc’d) will also bring our procurement manager.

We can do Thu 10/23 11:00–11:45am PT. That works best for our team. Please confirm and include an agenda so attendees know the focus.

Quick answers to background Qs:
- POC stakeholders: Product (Sara), Engineering lead (Devon), Procurement (TBD)
- Procurement runway: target decision by end of Nov, but Procurement would like a clear quote + procurement checklist from you prior to legal review.

—Sara

- Kimberly: please prep a short list of legal/pricing caveats we commonly see in Marketplace deals (licensing, support SLA, data residency notes).
